entities.name: Query RlmN protein
observations: 352 aa protein; calculated molecular mass 38.14 kDa and theoretical pI 8.47.
Contains Pfam RlmN_N at residues 7–59 and Radical_SAM at residues 109–275.
Has strong homology to reviewed RlmN proteins: 73.6–74.6% identity over approximately 96% query coverage.
Likely binds one [4Fe-4S] cluster coordinated by three cysteines and uses S-adenosyl-L-methionine.

entities.name: RlmN
observations: Methylates adenine C2 in 23S rRNA at A2503 and adenine C2 in tRNA at A37.
Uses SAM and a [4Fe-4S] cluster; catalysis proceeds through an S-methylcysteine intermediate.

entities.name: RlmN rRNA methylation
observations: Adenosine(2503) in 23S rRNA is converted to 2-methyladenosine(2503), with SAM-dependent radical chemistry producing 5'-deoxyadenosine, methionine, and S-adenosylhomocysteine; reduced ferredoxin supplies electrons.

entities.name: RlmN tRNA methylation
observations: Adenosine(37) in tRNA is converted to 2-methyladenosine(37), with SAM-dependent radical chemistry producing 5'-deoxyadenosine, methionine, and S-adenosylhomocysteine; reduced ferredoxin supplies electrons.
